programs.title: My Lottery Dream Home
programs.desc: After a man hit it big in Las Vegas on his wife's birthday, a couple is ready to find a quiet spot where they can raise their family away from the bright lights of the Strip. David Bromstad is joining the happy couple and will help them find the perfect family home far from the commotion of the city.

programs.title: Help! I Wrecked My House
programs.desc: Confident from renovating their last home, retirees take on a more complicated project. Jasmine steps in to transform their kitchen with an eclectic beachy style.

programs.title: Renovation 911
programs.desc: When an ice dam floods their business partner's brand new house, Lindsey and Kirsten are immediately called to action. Also, a client reaches out when a sewer backs up and floods her rental property, displacing the mom and two kids who live there.

programs.desc: With their apartment lease about to expire, a couple has only one month to find a new place in Los Angeles. She wants glitz, glam, and closet space in her new home, but he's looking to save money and is open to consider buying a fixer.
